title: Comparing Potential Energies
body: Box A has mass $$4\, \text{kg}$$ and sits at a height of $$5\, \text{m}$$. $$Box$$ $$B$$ $$has$$ $$mass$$ $$2\, \text{kg}$$ and sits at a height of $$8\, \text{m}$$. $$ \cup se$$ $$g=9.8\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$ and take the ground as the reference.
